P_calibration.quote: Agencies and courts may read the text purposively against the title, and sponsors will likely close visible gaps before or after enactment.

P_holdback.quote: Pointing out loopholes in committee may prompt sponsors to tighten them. The vagueness, delegation, and workability items (8–11, 29, 35, 37, 41–43) are probably the strongest "unworkable as written" arguments without that risk.

P_grandfather_step.quote: initiating a nominal run before enactment could be used to claim grandfathered status

P_reliance_caveat.quote: Planning operations around them if the bill passes is a separate decision, because §5(b) carries up to 10 years' imprisonment.
